name: Bauernhof Bichlhof
beschreibung: The traditional Bauernhof Bichlhof in Ebbs is an authentic Tyrolean farmhouse inn providing comfortable lodgings and hearty regional dining. Its idyllic rural setting offers guests peace, fresh air, and deep relaxation in close touch with nature. The kitchen takes pride in serving delicious regional products sourced directly from local farming. The area around Ebbs is celebrated for its scenic hiking and cycling trails, while the historic town of Kufstein and its iconic fortress are located just a short drive away.
